in_sanskrit.name: अनिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is not associated with anything, the one who is detached.

in_telugu.name: అనికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Not owned by anyone, belonging to all

in_marathi.name: Anikaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anikaa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Anika’ which means ‘unique’ or ‘graceful’. In Hindu mythology, Anikaa is a name given to the goddess of knowledge, Saraswati. She is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument) and is considered the embodiment of knowledge, music, art, and wisdom.
